named-query-graphql-omission-satisfied.description: The current schema allows omission, or the operation default satisfies it.

named-query-graphql-default-help.description: On omission, the named-query default applies first, then the operation default. Defaults never replace explicit null, false, zero or empty text. The required flag must match GraphQL nullability.

named-query-graphql-path-help.description: Use arrays of literal response alias segments, for example ["matches","nodes"]. Result paths start at GraphQL data; mapping paths start at each item. [] selects the item itself.

named-query-graphql-path-invalid.description: Enter a JSON array of string path segments.

named-query-graphql-page-help.description: Lookup previews run only compatible first-page definitions, with at most 25 records and no exact total. The server owns first and after. Valid definitions without an adapter can still be saved.

named-query-graphql-schema-help.description: Inspect the current caller-scoped read schema. Use its field names, arguments, input types and enum values when editing the query.

named-query-graphql-schema-error.description: Current GraphQL schema unavailable. Your draft is retained.

named-query-graphql-lookup-ready.description: This definition can power an authenticated lookup.

named-query-graphql-nonlookup.description: Valid definitions can be saved without lookup capability. Repair the following lookup settings before selecting one in a form or running a lookup preview.

named-query-graphql-preview-bound.description: First page only, at most 25 results. The exact total is unknown. Preview uses your current record access.

named-query-graphql-save-error.description: Failed to save GraphQL named query: {{error}}

named-query-diagnostic-location.description: Source line and column shown only for located diagnostics.

named-query-untracked-callers-note.description: Known usage discovery is incomplete for dynamic hooks, API callers and opaque configuration references.

data-grids-promotion-help.description: This is an unsaved copy of your current exploration. Review candidate mappings and choose ownership for every variable before saving.

data-grids-promotion-provenance.description: The explorer reference is informational. Editing either saved definition leaves the other independent.

data-grids-promotion-save-help.description: Save creates an immediately available named query. Your exploration stays unchanged.

data-grids-promotion-value-help.description: Choosing Fixed copies this value. A consumer parameter has no named-query default until you enter one.

data-grids-promotion-validation-failed.description: Validation is unavailable. Your detached draft is retained; change a field to retry.

data-grids-promotion-denied.description: Named-query create permission is required. Your exploration and detached draft are retained.

data-grids-promotion-name-exists.description: That named-query name already exists. Choose a unique name and save again.

data-grids-promotion-save-failed.description: The named query could not be saved. Your detached draft is retained; try saving again.

data-grids-promotion-discard-help.description: Your original exploration and its unsaved changes will be retained.

data-grids-promotion-invalid-values.description: Correct the explorer variables JSON before creating a named query.

data-grids-promotion-open-failed.description: The named-query editor could not be opened. Your exploration is retained; check its fields and try again.

data-grids-promotion-saved.description: Named query created. Your exploration and its unsaved changes are retained.

data-grids-promotion-init-failed.description: The named-query editor could not load. Your exploration and detached draft are retained.

data-grids-promotion-disabled.description: Record GraphQL is disabled. Your exploration is retained; ask an administrator to enable it before trying again.

data-grids-promotion-timeout.description: Preparing the named query timed out. Your exploration is retained; try again.

data-grids-promotion-unavailable.description: Record GraphQL is temporarily unavailable. Your exploration is retained; try again later.

data-grids-promotion-schema-changed.description: Available fields or filter types changed. Your exploration is retained; review its fields and filters before trying again.

data-grids-field-group-record.description: Fallback group heading for record system fields in the explorer catalogue

data-grids-field-group-metadata.description: Fallback group heading for metadata without a labelled form container

data-grids-keyboard-column-help.description: Drag to reorder, or use arrow keys on a focused chip. Home and End move it to the beginning or end.

data-grids-repeating-note.description: sub-fields belong to repeating groups. Add the group column and open a cell to see every value.

data-grids-visual-readonly.description: This query was unlinked for GraphQL editing. Visual controls are read-only. Run uses the GraphQL query. Start a new query to use the Visual builder again.

data-grids-graphql-linked.description: Generated from the Visual tab. It updates when you change conditions or columns there. To edit it here, unlink it; the Visual tab then becomes read-only for this query.

data-grids-graphql-unlinked.description: You are editing this query in GraphQL. The Visual tab is read-only; both tabs run the same query.

data-grids-query-check-help.description: Check the document, variable values and current schema before running this query.

data-grids-insert-field-help.description: After unlinking, click a field to add it to the records selection.

data-grids-promotion-linked-help.description: The saved explorer query and this named query stay linked.

data-grids-save-before-publish.description: Save this query first so the named query can link to its saved revision. Publishing continues after saving.

nq-section-name-help.description: Use letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, with no spaces and at most 120 characters — for example active_research_plans. The name collections is reserved.

nq-section-parameters-help.description: Choose what callers can change. Everything else stays as saved.

nq-section-lookup-help.description: Choose what each suggestion stores and shows in the form. Also store accepts a selected object.

nq-section-invalid-paths.description: Enter an object of mapping names and arrays of literal path segments.

nq-section-preview-help.description: Preview reads real records using your current access. It does not save the query.

nq-section-preview-failed.description: Preview could not run. Check the parameters, query and your access, then try again.

nq-section-lookup-paging-required.description: A form lookup needs a records query with first and after variables, nodes and page information. Edit it in GraphQL before publishing as a lookup.

nq-section-check-settings.description: Check the parameter choices and mappings. Every required variable needs a saved value or a caller-provided value.

nq-section-lookup-check.description: Choose a caller-provided search parameter, a stored value and a label to use this query in forms.

nq-section-caller-access.description: Runs as the person calling the query. It does not grant extra record access.

nq-section-review-help.description: This update changes the query contract. Review the consumers below before applying it.

nq-section-review-limit.description: Hooks and direct API callers may also use this query. ReDBox cannot list every consumer.

data-grids-promotion-query-changed.description: The query changed while publishing was opening. Save your changes and try again.

nq-ux-how-start.description: How do you want to start?

nq-ux-start-saved-help.description: Use a query built in the Record explorer. It stays linked to it.

nq-ux-start-graphql-help.description: Open the Record explorer to build a new query and see its results.

nq-ux-start-database-help.description: Use the database editor for reports and CSV export.

nq-ux-no-saved-help.description: Build and save a query in the Record explorer, then return here to make it reusable.

nq-ux-chooser-help.description: Continue to review the conditions and choose which values callers can change. Nothing is published until you save.

nq-ux-chooser-load-error.description: Saved queries could not be loaded. Try again.

nq-ux-source-conflict.description: This saved query changed while you were choosing it. Select its current version and continue again.

nq-ux-source-gone.description: This saved query is no longer available. Choose another query.

nq-ux-source-denied.description: You need permission to create named queries in this portal. Your current draft has been kept.

nq-ux-prepare-error.description: This query could not be prepared. Check that its fields are available in the Record explorer, then try again.

nq-ux-source-missing-help.description: The saved query was removed or is no longer available here. This named query still works with its published document. Choose another source to replace the link.

nq-ux-source-changed-help.description: The saved query has changed since this named query was published. The published query stays as it is until you review and save an update.

nq-ux-source-draft-updated.description: The current saved query is now in your draft. Review the parameters and lookup fields, then save to publish the update.

nq-ux-source-independent.description: This named query uses its own published document. Changes in the explorer take effect here only after you review and save an update.

nq-ux-linked-readonly.description: This linked document is read-only here. Edit and save its source in the Record explorer, then review an update here.

nq-ux-handwritten-help.description: This GraphQL query was written by hand. Edit its document and bindings here, or choose a saved query to link it.

nq-ux-checks-passed.description: The query and its variable bindings are valid.

nq-ux-preview-values.description: Enter JSON values for numbers, yes/no values and lists. Text values do not need quotes.

nq-ux-preview-error.description: The preview could not run. Check the document, test values and available fields, then try again.

nq-ux-save-conflict.description: The source or published query changed while you were editing. Your draft is kept. Reopen the current query or choose the source again, then review and save.

nq-ux-empty-conditions.description: All accessible records in this scope.

nq-ux-diagnostic-DUPLICATE_PARAMETER.description: Give each caller parameter a unique name. Paging names are reserved.

nq-ux-diagnostic-GRAPHQL_CONTEXT_REQUIRE.description: Sign in with an authorized account before validating this query.

nq-ux-diagnostic-GRAPHQL_OPERATION.description: Use a single read-only query operation.

nq-ux-diagnostic-GRAPHQL_SCHEMA.description: A selected field, argument or variable is unavailable or has changed. Check it against the current schema.

nq-ux-diagnostic-GRAPHQL_SYNTAX.description: Check the GraphQL syntax at the indicated line and column.

nq-ux-diagnostic-INPUT_TYPE.description: Match each caller parameter to its variable type. Use a scalar, choice or list of these values.

nq-ux-diagnostic-INVALID_DEFAULT.description: A saved value or default does not match its variable type. Correct it under Advanced.

nq-ux-diagnostic-INVALID_DEFINITION.description: Check the document, variable choices and result paths. Some settings are incomplete or invalid.

nq-ux-diagnostic-INVALID_SCOPE.description: Choose one available record type and compatible workflow stages.

nq-ux-diagnostic-LOOKUP_MAPPING.description: Choose a stored value and label that are present in every suggestion.

nq-ux-diagnostic-LOOKUP_PAGE_REQUIRED.description: Set up first-page paging to use this query in a form lookup.

nq-ux-diagnostic-LOOKUP_PAGE_SHAPE.description: Select the records list and its continuation fields. Declare separate first and after paging variables.

nq-ux-diagnostic-LOOKUP_SEARCH_BINDING.description: Choose a text parameter used by a query condition for the text the user types.

nq-ux-diagnostic-MAPPING_PATH.description: A mapped field is no longer selected in every result. Choose another field or correct its path under Advanced.

nq-ux-diagnostic-PAGE_VARIABLE.description: Declare both paging variables in the query document.

nq-ux-diagnostic-QUERY_LIMIT.description: The query exceeds a server limit. Reduce its size or number of selections.

nq-ux-diagnostic-REQUIRED_CONTRACT.description: The caller parameter requirement must match its GraphQL variable type.

nq-ux-diagnostic-REQUIRED_VARIABLE.description: Choose a saved value or caller parameter for each required condition.

nq-ux-diagnostic-RESULT_PATH.description: Choose the selected result list under Advanced. Nested lists cannot be flattened.

nq-ux-diagnostic-UNKNOWN_RECORD_TYPE.description: This record type is no longer available. Review the source in the Record explorer.

nq-ux-diagnostic-UNKNOWN_VARIABLE.description: Remove bindings for variables that the document no longer declares.

nq-ux-diagnostic-UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW_STAGE.description: A workflow stage is no longer available. Review the source in the Record explorer.

nq-ux-diagnostic-UNSAFE_PATH.description: Choose a valid result field. Paths must use literal property names.

nq-ux-diagnostic-VARIABLE_OWNERSHIP.description: Choose how each condition gets its value. Paging variables are managed by ReDBox.

nq-ux-diagnostic-GRAPHQL_DISABLED.description: Record queries are disabled. Ask an administrator to enable GraphQL.

nq-ux-diagnostic-GRAPHQL_SCHEMA_UNAVAILA.description: The current schema could not be loaded. Your draft is kept; try again.

named-query-error-name-spaces.description: Names can't contain spaces. Use letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens — for example active_research_plans.

named-query-error-name-invalid.description: Names can only contain letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens — for example active_research_plans.

named-query-error-name-long.description: Names must be 120 characters or fewer.

named-query-error-name-reserved.description: The name collections is reserved. Choose a different name.

named-query-error-collection-required.description: Choose a collection in Basics before saving.

report-graphql-export-wait.description: Export in progress. Please wait while ReDBox checks each page.

report-graphql-export-complete.description: Export complete. Your CSV download is ready.

report-graphql-export-failed.description: The report could not be completed. Try again, or ask an administrator to check the query.

report-graphql-live-data.description: Results are live. Changes during paging or export can affect which records appear; this is not a snapshot.

report-graphql-query-changed.description: The named query has changed. Review its fields and filters, then accept the current version and save the report.

report-graphql-paging-required.description: This query is missing the paging fields needed for reports. Re-publish it from the Record explorer, then select the published query.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_QUERY_CHANGE.description: The named query has changed. Review its fields and filters, then accept the current version and save the report.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_CURSOR_INVAL.description: This page link is expired or no longer matches the report, filters or your access. Run the report again from the first page.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_EXPORT_ROW_L.description: The export exceeds its row limit. No partial CSV was downloaded. Narrow the query or ask an administrator to increase the limit.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_EXPORT_PAGE_.description: The export exceeds its page limit. No partial CSV was downloaded. Narrow the query and try again.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_EXPORT_BYTE_.description: The export exceeds its file size limit. No partial CSV was downloaded. Choose fewer columns or narrow the query.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_EXPORT_TIMEO.description: The export reached its time limit. No partial CSV was downloaded. Narrow the query and try again.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_OFFSET_UNSUP.description: This report uses Next and Previous to page through its results. Run it again from the first page.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_PAGE_INVALID.description: Choose a valid page size and run the report again.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_CURSOR_UNAVA.description: Report paging is not configured. Ask an administrator to check the shared cursor secret.

report-graphql-error-REPORT_LIMIT_CONFIG.description: Report export limits are not configured correctly. Ask an administrator to check them.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_CONTEXT_REQ.description: Sign in again before running or exporting this report.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_REPORT_PAGI.description: This query is missing the paging fields needed for reports. Re-publish it from the Record explorer, then select the published query.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_EXECUTION_F.description: The record query failed while running this report. Try again, or ask an administrator to check the named query.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_RESULT_INVA.description: The query returned an unexpected result collection or paging fields. Re-publish it from the Record explorer and review the report columns.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_ROW_INVALID.description: The query returned an unexpected record value. Re-publish it from the Record explorer and review the report columns.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_DISABLED.description: GraphQL reports are currently unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the GraphQL configuration.

report-graphql-error-UNAVAILABLE.description: The report service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

report-graphql-error-QUERY_TIMEOUT.description: This report took too long. Narrow its filters and try again.

report-graphql-error-QUERY_LIMIT.description: This report exceeds its data or work limit. Narrow its filters and try again.

report-graphql-error-COLLECTION_LIMIT.description: This report could not finish a page within its work limit. Narrow its filters and try again.

report-graphql-error-INVALID_GRAPHQL_NAM.description: The query no longer matches the available record fields. Ask an administrator to review it.

report-graphql-error-INVALID_GRAPHQL_PAR.description: Check the report filter values and try again.

report-graphql-preview-help.description: GraphQL report automatic first page preview guidance

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_LOOKUP_UNSU.description: This query cannot provide report results. Re-publish it from the Record explorer, then select the published query.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_OFFSET_UNSU.description: This report uses Next and Previous to page through its results. Run it again from the first page.

report-graphql-error-GRAPHQL_PAGE_INVALI.description: Choose a valid page size and run the report again.

report-graphql-error-INPUT_LIMIT.description: The report or its filter values are too large. Use fewer columns or shorter filter values.

report-graphql-error-COMPLEXITY_LIMIT.description: The report configuration is too complex. Use fewer columns or simpler templates.

report-graphql-error-MAPPING_LIMIT.description: The report contains too many field mappings. Reduce the selected fields and try again.

report-graphql-error-PREVIEW_TIMEOUT.description: The report preview took too long. Narrow its filters and try again.

report-graphql-error-FORBIDDEN.description: You do not have access to preview this report. Sign in with an account that has report access.
